# Support

## Bugs and feature requests

File a [GitHub Issue](https://github.com/Caezarr/bowimi-mcp/issues). Include MCP client (Cursor, Claude Desktop, etc.), Node version, and the tool call that failed.

## Security vulnerabilities

Use [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/Caezarr/bowimi-mcp/security/advisories/new) — never paste API keys in public issues. See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

## Questions

Best-effort only; no support SLA for this personal MCP server.
